programme.title: Paper Tales (2024)
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. Jenny and Blam never refuse to help anyone, but it often happens that they’re the ones who need help, since Jenny’s still a kid and Blam’s an eccentric teddy bear.

La aparición de un niño que se ofrece a cuidarlo establece una siniestra relación de deseo, venganza y apropiación de personalidad.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Es un misterio por qué una ancianita está rompiendo reflectores frente a un centro turístico costero recién construido. El equipo pronto descubre que ZARA está tratando de ayudar a las tortugas recién nacidas a llegar desde sus nidos hasta el mar. Pero la confusa contaminación lumínica no es la única amenaza que enfrentan, los depredadores acechan y un derrame de petróleo en el mar las espera. Es una batalla en tres frentes para salvar a las tortugas, pero los niños tienen tres cosas a su favor: superpoderes, gran inteligencia y redes de seda de araña sintética.

programme.title: Silencio en la nieve (2026)
programme.desc: En plena Segunda Guerra Mundial, un asesino en serie aparece dentro de la División Azul, cuerpo de soldados españoles voluntarios que combatieron en el frente ruso junto a las tropas alemanas. Tras el hallazgo del cadáver de un soldado español que ha sido degollado y presenta en el hombro una inscripción grabada a cuchillo ("Mira que te mira Dios"), se abre una investigación de la que se encarga el soldado Arturo Andrade, que asume la tarea con rigor y profesionalidad. Arturo cuenta con la ayuda del Sargento Espinosa, y pronto ambos empiezan a sospechar que detrás del asesinato se ocultan oscuros secretos del pasado.

programme.title: Kill Kane (2024)

Leaving the Odyssea at the dock, they hop on a bay boat outfitted with a trolling motor for the ultimate inshore adventure. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: SoCal summer is calling, and the Local Knowledge crew is back on Ali’s home turf in San Diego, California. With reports of hot bites and fish moving in, the crew faces a classic Southern California dilemma — chase big yellowtail around the Coronado Islands or head north in search of bluefin tuna. The options are plenty, the challenges are real, and that’s exactly what keeps fishing in SoCal so exciting.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it’s time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43’ custom ACI Catamaran "Killer Bee". Armed with the right crew, the right gear, and a never-quit mindset, the guys roll the dice on an overnight move—hoping to wake up to redemption and put a few quality bluefin on deck.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Troy admite engañar a Kela con su amiga y duda si sigue haciéndolo. Michael niega ser el padre del hijo de la joven Nikki, quien dice haberlo omitido del acta para protegerlo.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Sarah confronta a su novio y a la mujer con la que se rumorea que tuvo una cita; Thomas profesa una conexión emocional con la novia de su amigo; Tootie le da malas noticias a su novio y a su entrometida hermana.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Tish encuentra malas noticias mientras husmea en el celular de su amiga; Kalia quiere al novio de Victoria; CJ culpa a su esposa por su infidelidad.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: La novia de Nick descubre por qué él pasa tanto tiempo con su vecina; el novio de Osha tiene una aventura con su amiga; Brandi resiente el comportamiento imprudente de su novio después de todos los sacrificios que ha hecho para mantener su relación.

programme.sub-title: Mi hermana stripper ataca de nuevo

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Dos personas son estafadas por el Ejército Nacional al acudir a ellos con la cédula militar de sus familiares.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Un sospechoso de un suicidio se desliza en las sombras de la impunidas y envenena la vida de dos gemelas menores, cuyo destino final parece sellado por sus mismas manos. Un sistema judicial lento y desbordado permite que la tragedia se repita.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Durante la pandemia, hubo cuerpos identificados incorrectamente, lo que dejó a muchas familias inseguras.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Carolina, de 48 años y de nacionalidad venezolana, cuenta su experiencia en el modelaje webcam.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los piques ilegales siguen causando muertes y accidentes graves, dejando víctimas inocentes. A pesar de no estar tipificados como delito, aumentan la inseguridad, lo que genera demandas por leyes más estrictas para frenar esta práctica peligrosa.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Varios compradores en Colombia enfrentan el incumplimiento de Constructores que no entregan sus viviendas. Tras años de espera, demandan por estafa y negligencia, mientras los proyectos siguen paralizados o en problemas legales.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Rubén Andrade desapareció el 12 de abril de 2020 en Bosa. Su cuerpo fue hallado 4 días después en Soacha. Su ex, Yendi Paola, confesó haberlo envenenado y apuñalado, luego arrojó el cuerpo al río con ayuda de un taxista.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Bryan Steven Rivera, un niño de 7 años, desapareció en la zona cafetera de Colombia; una testigo relató que un hombre lo atrajo con dulces. La investigación llevó a un retrato hablado de "El Peruano", identificado como Carlos Alberto Gómez Loaiza, con antecedentes por abuso sexual violento. Reconocido por testigos, fue detenido en Pereira para responder por la desaparición del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Ángela Carolina fue hallada muerta en Villa Rica, Tolima. John Fredy, movido por odio hacia su esposa infiel, confesó el crimen y fue condenado a 36 años por el asesinato de Carolina y su esposa. Luego intentó cambiar su versión, sin éxito.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2015, en Arboledas, Norte de Santander, Cecilio Villamizar, el "Monstruo de Castro", abusó sexualmente de su hija de 13 años y asesinó a su hermano cuando este le pidió entregarse. Meses después mató también a su tío por temor a ser delatado. Finalmente, la menor rompió su silencio y denunció los abusos ante la Fiscalía. Villamizar fue condenado a 27 años de prisión por acceso carnal violento, acto sexual abusivo y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Cindy Piña fue asesinada por su ex Edinson Dussán en abril de 2020 en Neiva, tras visitarlo para ver a sus hijos. Estaba embarazada de su nueva pareja. Él la enterró en el patio y confesó.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Dos mujeres en Popayán, toman la decisión equivocada de invitar dos hombres a su casa para tomarse unos tragos, estos se drogan, se emborrachan y deciden que van a matarlas, en seguida los hombres huyen creyendo que habían asesinado a las dos mujeres, con lo que no contaban los atacantes, era que una de las víctimas sobreviviera y fuera testigo de los hechos.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Cuatro policías colombianos se infiltraron en África occidental, haciéndose pasar por turistas, profesores y médicos, para rescatar a la hermana Gloria Narváez, secuestrada por Al Qaeda en Malí durante cuatro años. El Coronel Gustavo Camargo lideró esta misión casi suicida, negociando en las entrañas del grupo terrorista. Tras años de estrategia y paciencia, la monja fue liberada sin disparos ni violencia.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: En 2021, miles de migrantes haitianos, venezolanos y cubanos cruzaron el peligroso Tapón del Darién hacia Estados Unidos. Los Informantes siguió a Mikabens Meneus y su familia, quienes tras varados un mes en Necoclí, pagaron miles de dólares para atravesar la selva, enfrentando coyotes, pandillas y condiciones infrahumanas en busca del sueño americano.

programme.sub-title: 3 hombres examinados... ¿Cuál es el padre de mi bebé?
programme.desc: ¡Brittany cree que Dionte es el padre de su bebé y lo demostrará! Después, Melissa, de 24 años, afirma que Rob, de 47 años, es el padre de su bebé, ¡pero la hija de Rob quiere pruebas! Además, ¿el padre del bebé de Crystal es su ex, el primo de su ex, o su marido?

programme.title: Maury

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Nina goes to great lengths to throw an extravagant 32nd birthday party for herself. The daylong event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music. The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement. Malcolm & Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid. A dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland. Musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A temp worker hopes to turn her gig as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help. A wedding is interrupted. Local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto. Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the "Soft Opening" of their Bed and Breakfast. A magazine features a local furniture maker in their "Man Issue." Steampunks attend a convention. Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The City of Portland is overrun with art projects. Fred and Carrie's relationship is complicated by their roommate, Alexandra. A movie theater sells artisanal concessions. The consultants from "Japanese Toys, Cool Offices" get to work.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Rats decide to move out of their newly gentrified neighborhood. First-time parents read various child-rearing books. Gahvin and his girlfriend go to the movies. Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Electricity is shut off for the entire City of Portland due to unpaid bills at the Mayor's Office. Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast. Kath and Dave go into survival mode.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A young woman (Kirsten Dunst) is haunted by very informed ghosts. Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another. Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes. Sandra finally finds a soulmate. Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Ecoterrorists (including Olivia Wilde) protest animal testing at makeup company. Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out! Toni and Candace have a car wash. Fred misses hip hop.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A celery salesman (Steve Buscemi) goes to great lengths to get celery back on the table. 911 dispatchers assure callers that it's beets. The Order Grill is open for lunch. Carrie declares social bankruptcy.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A punk from the '80s wakes up from a coma. An e-mail goes neglected. Nina has surprising news for Lance. Malcolm and Kris tailgate a Prairie Home Companion live show. Carrie dates a tax lawyer.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Peter drives Nance to the emergency room. Spyke gets a car. Ghavin has some questions for a singer (Annie Clark) whose band is touring through Portland. Fred and Carrie have a garage sale.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Carrie and Fred go home after a concert. Fred has an idea for a music documentary. Peter is reunited with his old band, The Bahama Knights and his ex-wife lead singer (Maya Rudolph). Guest starring Maya Rudolph, Tuck & Patti, and Jeff Tweedy.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Kickstarter videos compete at the Can'ts Film Festival (hosted by Gus Van Sant). Toni and Candace coach the Portland Trail Blazers' dance team. Guest starring Gus Van Sant, Paul Allen, The Portland Trail Blazers & dancers.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Brendan and Michelle decide that it's finally time to try drugs. Carrie's brother (Josh Homme) comes to visit with his new boyfriend. Women and Women First is visited by the cops. Guest starring Kyle MacLachlan, Dan Savage, and Josh Homme.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Mr. Mayor (Kyle MacLachlan) unveils Portland's official 3D Printer. Santa is concerned about the future of Christmas. A minister (Ed Begley Jr.) reminds us that church is an option.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: Portlandia gets away for the weekend to New Beavertown, Oregon. Toni and Candace lead a feminist moon retreat for women (including k.d. lang).

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.sub-title: The Story of Toni and Candace
programme.desc: The origin story of the feminist bookstore. A merger between two corporate book retailers pits young, sexy, shoulder-pad-wearing Toni and Candace against one another in fierce competition to be head of the Chick Lit Department.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A visit from Lance's mom and her new boyfriend puts pressure on Lance and Nina's relationship. Guest starring Justin Long.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: A series of health ailments creates a desperate search for medical solutions. Guest starring Ed Begley Jr. and Brigitte Nielsen.

programme.title: Portlandia
programme.desc: The Ecoterrorists travel to San Diego to take down their next target, Seaworld. Guest starring Jeff Goldblum and Natasha Lyonne.

programme.title: Portlandia

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: NPL

Whether you're a seasoned fan or new to the NPL, this match showcases the rising talent and intensity of women’s pro pickleball. Every point matters — and momentum can shift in a flash.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.sub-title: NCPA 2026 - Loyola Marymount University vs. Baylor University
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the NCPA Nationals in Saint Louis as the LMU Lions and Baylor Bears battle in a high-stakes best-of-seven series. The competition ignites with the Racing speed of rapid-fire volleys during an intense "equipment battle" between the power of the Selkirk Boomstick and the precision of Team Joola. Masterful Skills are on display as athletes execute flawless Around the Post (ATP) winners and tactical dink rallies that keep the pressure mounting. Amidst the Freestyle creativity of the collegiate circuit, witness morale-shifting momentum swings and desperate scrapping for every point as these top-tier programs fight for national dominance.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.sub-title: US Open 2025 - Pro Women's Doubles - Waters/Waters vs. Fuzesi/Maalouf
programme.desc: Watch as the formidable mother-daughter duo, Lee and Anna Leigh Waters, take on challengers from North Carolina in this Pro Women's Doubles match from the US National Pickleball Center. After an injury, it is great to see the champions partner up again, demonstrating the "fire and ice" style of play that has made them national champions. While the Waters team's game one was a quick 11-point victory, the challengers, Fuzesi and Maloof, handled themselves well on the championship court. The players at home can learn from Anna Leigh's "instigator" shots and two-handed backhand rolls, which she helped bring to the big stage.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The interim-GLORY Heavyweight Title will be up for grabs as top ranked heavyweight contender Antonio Plazibat (22-4, 16 KO) collides with the number two ranked Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (24-2-1, 12 KO) in the main event. These teammates will have to put their friendship aside for one night and go head-to-head for GLORY gold. Also on the card are title fights in the Middleweight, Welterweight and Light Heavyweight divisions.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The undisputed heavyweight king of kickboxing will be decided in the main event as long reigning champion Rico Verhoeven (60-10, 20 KO) goes up against arguably his most dangerous opponent to date in interim-heavyweight champ Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-2-1, 13 KO). Middleweight champ Donovan Wisse (19-1, 10 KO) puts his title on the line against number one contender Michael Boapeah (16-3-1, 7 KO). Wisse has looked unstoppable so far during his title run but now he faces an in-form Michael Boapeah who holds a win over the only man to beat Wisse. The welterweight division sees top ranked stars go head-to-head as Hamicha (40-2, 30 KO) takes on Diaguely Camara (24-4-1, 10 KO) and Jay Overmeer (29-5, 15 KO) meets Chico Kwasi (41-5, 22 KO). It’s also an important evening at middleweight with Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-8, 36 KO) colliding with Ulric Bokeme (31-4, 17 KO) and the recently debuted Iliass Hammouche (33-6, 7 KO) facing Ivan Galaz (58-10-1, 15 KO). A huge featherweight match-up between the number one ranked Abraham Vidales (15-2, 12 KO) and number two ranked Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO) plus an exciting light heavyweight bout between Ibrahim El Bouni (41-8-1, 22 KO) and Stefan Latescu (16-2, 7 KO) will round out the main card.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: Christian pide que Cecilia le dé una compensación porque se masturbó en su taxi y subió el video a la red. Está asustado porque su esposa es viuda de tres hombres que murieron sospechosamente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Hija de migrantes intenta quitarse de encima ese estigma y elimina su lengua natal, el español. En otro caso, Favo y Tormento son raperos y se enfrentan por la letra de una canción.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vianey quiere proteger a su hermana, pues su madre permitió que su padrastro la abusara sexualmente. Clara le disputa a César la custodia de sus dos hijos, lo considera una mala influencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Dedos de hielo; Almas gemelas asesinas
programme.desc: Mariana sufre del síndrome de Raynaud que provoca sensibilidad al frío en los dedos, no quiere mudarse a otra ciudad. Nancy fue secuestrada y ahora siente una conexión especial con su captor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Difamado por venganza; La novia loca
programme.desc: Anthony fue investigado por el delito de pornografía infantil, él cree que su suegra lo incriminó. Lina tiene obsesión con casarse, pero Carlos no quiere poner en riesgo su estatus migratorio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Abusado por mi héroe; Testigo ilegal
programme.desc: Alejandro fue abusado de niño por un creador de videojuegos, exige compensación aunque su atacante está muerto. Cristian testifica en la corte y lo arrestan, ahora quiere recuperar a su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mi nieto abandonado en el aeropuerto; Falsa fortuna
programme.desc: Grisel quiere la custodia de su nieto porque la mamá, Gabriela, casi lo deja abandonado en el aeropuerto. Además, Edgar encuentra pepitas de oro dentro de los salmones que le vendió Rubén.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El pasado oscuro; DUI mató a mi hijo
programme.desc: Daniel buscó a su esposa por mucho tiempo y, ahora que logra encontrarla, descubre que ella está casada con otro. El marido de Alejandra conducía ebrio y por accidente mata al hijo de Willie.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dalila, modelo de pasarela, fue discriminada en el evento que organizó Karla, le impidieron participar por tener síndrome de Down sin tomar en cuenta su enorme talento para desfilar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: José, el enano; Problema de niños
programme.desc: Lourdes está casada con José, ella le exige que acepte su discapacidad, pero él se niega porque se siente sano y fuerte. Dos niñas se enfrentan por unos "tickets" para ir a Euro Disney en París.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Aire mortal; El emú y la esmeralda
programme.desc: Ernesto sufre las consecuencias de tener un vecino obsesionado con las armas. Además, Lily exige que un emú sea operado porque se tragó la esmeralda que estaba en su anillo de matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Peligro de mar; La venganza del huevo
programme.desc: George tuvo un accidente en bote con su hija y ahora la madre exige la custodia, porque el padre alcoholizado no supo cuidarla. Roni mete huevos en las paredes por venganza contra su hermana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Karen, menor de edad, es fanática de los tatuajes, pero sufre serios daños al hacerse uno en el brazo. Melisa le inyecta a su abuelo su propia sangre porque él quiere rejuvenecer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: Camilo exige que su esposa vuelva a casa y lo atienda, cuando quedó ciego, ella lo abandonó. Vanessa pide que invaliden el traspaso de su inmueble porque actuó bajo los efectos de una brujería.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ninoska le repara una pieza dental a Mari que antes le había dado problemas, ahora enfrenta una demanda. Le pasan la lengua a los helados y luego los devuelven, para dañarle el negocio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El secreto peligroso; Culpa y capricho
programme.desc: Carolina dice que Patricia oculta un pasado que afecta la relación, ella le reprocha el haberlo destapado. Quiere el divorcio de su esposa porque siente que es un depravado sexual.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: La madre de Eduardo está en vida vegetal y ahora su padre reaparece para recuperar a la familia. Por otro lado, Fernando descubre que su ex involucra a su niño en estafas de seguros de autos.

programme.desc: Rutila decide actuar por su propia cuenta, a espaldas de su familia, para rescatar a su hermana, pero surge un obstáculo en su camino a Suiza. Diana le informa a la familia que ubicaron al Cabo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al mejor estilo de Aurelio, el Cartel de los Casillas contraataca a sus enemigos. Pío José y Ojeda pagan las consecuencias. Ámbar conspira contra los gobiernos cubano y venezolano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pío José Valdivia, el enemigo más peligroso de los Casillas, comienza a ejecutar su venganza para eliminarlos uno por uno. El primero en su lista es Súper Javi; él se prepara.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado y Diana llegan a Grecia en busca de nuevos aliados para fortalecer el Cartel de los Casillas. Pero la mafia de Los Balcanes tiene otras intenciones. Pío y Jaime buscan la presidencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado procura un encuentro con Renzo Volpi para hacer negocios, sin imaginar que el líder de los Balcanes le hará una petición que lo pondrá contra la pared. Corina tiene a Ojeda en la mira.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba decide enterrar a Aurelio junto a su hermano, Chacorta. Pero sus nietos tienen otros planes y cuando ella se entera, estalla en furia. Esther le declara la guerra a su hija, Diana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas le dan el último adiós con todos los honores a Aurelio, convertido en una leyenda. Con su muerte se fortalecen y nace el cartel con más poder. Amado y Diana terminan su relación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas mandan un impactante mensaje al mundo entero por cadena nacional. Ahora, sus enemigos preparan un plan de ataque para eliminar a cada miembro del nuevo cartel.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Un tesoro en el fondo del mar
programme.desc: Amado planea usar el botín que encontró con Athina para liberarla a ella y a su familia de la deuda que tiene con Volpi. El mafioso le da un ultimátum. Los Casillas preparan su regreso.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado y Volpi no llegan a un acuerdo por lo que se inicia una nueva guerra. Los ataques no se hacen esperar y un integrante de la familia Casillas está en la mira del enemigo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado se da cuenta de que Luz Marina corre peligro y avisa a la familia. Los Casillas le advierten a la joven, pero ella se niega a que la protejan. El Chema está dispuesto a matar a Navarro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema está dispuesto a matar al agente Navarro como sea. Utiliza a Ámbar como carnada y ataca sin piedad, sin importarle que ella pueda terminar muerta. Amado quiere eliminar a Volpi.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas descubren que Dylan está detrás del Chema e intentan avisarle. Pero es tarde, Pío ya lo tiene en la mira. Amado recuerda sus tiempos en la guerra junto a Volpi.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Volpi insiste en presionar a Amado para que trafique con el fentanilo, pero esta vez lo hace con su peor enemigo, Ojeda. Athina y Nikos celebran la boda de su hija y el enemigo se aparece.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado está preocupado por la vida de su sobrina y se ve obligado a aceptar las condiciones de Renzo Volpi, aun después de saber lo frío y brutal que puede ser. Ismael y Rutila discuten.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila decide actuar por su propia cuenta, a espaldas de su familia, para rescatar a su hermana, pero surge un obstáculo en su camino a Suiza. Diana le informa a la familia que ubicaron al Cabo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Renzo y Amado se declaran la guerra. El líder de los Balcanes da la orden a Ojeda de traerle a Diana Ahumada para dar el próximo golpe a su enemigo. Pío intenta escapar de las autoridades.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Volpi llega a México dispuesto a tener control del territorio de los Casillas. Como parte de su estrategia, busca alianza con el cartel más cercano a su enemigo. Diana enfrenta a su madre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema llega a reunirse con el cartel de los chinos para hacer negocios y se encuentra con el enemigo principal de los Casillas, quien pide una alianza para sacarlos del juego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila descubre que El Cabo sigue con vida tras el último enfrentamiento con los Casillas. Ahora, ella logra dar con él y planea eliminarlo definitivamente. Volpi está cerca de su objetivo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado encara a El Chema al enterarse de que está negociando con su principal enemigo. Esto causa un enfrentamiento entre ambos carteles que termina en pura violencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Con el diablo no se juega
programme.desc: Pío José quiere recuperar los 300 kilos de cocaína que Diana le robó; para lograrlo, manda a secuestrar a su mamá y hermana. Pero es él quien se lleva la sorpresa de su vida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas celebran la boda de doña Alba y Pulque, pero no todo es alegría cuando se enteran por televisión de una noticia alarmante. Ámbar se da cuenta de que Navarro le puso un localizador.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: La DEA detrás de El Chema
programme.desc: El Chema se la juega en Colombia para conseguir una gran cantidad de droga. Navarro tiene ubicado al capo y coordina un operativo para su captura. Amado tiene un mal presentimiento.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La gobernadora Ahumada acusa públicamente a Pío José de ser El Cabo y él va por ella a eliminarla. Pero los enemigos del colombiano llegan al mismo tiempo y se arma una balacera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Con el enemigo en la mira
programme.desc: Diana le avisa a su hermana que pronto va a estar con su mamá. Castillo logra interceptar la llamada y monta un operativo para capturar a los Casillas y rescatar a la gobernadora.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas hacen alianza con la DEA para entregar a la gobernadora. Pío aprovecha el momento, haciendo que Jaime se la entregue en bandeja de plata. Navarro pacta con Ámbar y Edith.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La gobernadora piensa que ya está lejos del peligro de los colombianos. Pero Jaime le avisa a Pío que van rumbo a Coahuila para que él pueda ejecutar su venganza. Chema recibe malas noticias.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El que se mete con El Cabo tiene los días contados. La gobernadora no le teme al narco colombiano, por el contrario, le da un golpe duro donde más le duele. Los Casillas buscan a Esther.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana pierde el control al enterarse de que ejecutaron a su madre. Amado le pide que mantenga la cabeza fría para afrontar la situación, pero ella lo único que quiere es hacer justicia.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker está con Briggite en su casa. Está borracho y se abrazan Yubiri se sobresalta en la cama. NO puede dormir | tiene pálpitos y está pensando en Wilker. Se lo comenta a Graciela. Llega Bienvenida y lo le dicen nada. Yubiri no puede dormir y se levanta a tomar un vaso de agua. También tiene angustia y pálpitos. Llega Lolita con los mismos sustos y pálpitos y se entera que Wilker rompió con Solymar. Wilker está totalmente borracho y le dice a Briggite que le gusta y que quiere estar con ella.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 264: Amores y Reconciliaciones: Los Sentimientos Revelados
programme.desc: En una plática entre madre e hija, Dileidy le platica a Gladis sobre su salida donde estaba con Aureliano y Gladis le cuenta su amor hacia Marco A. Mientras tanto, Egleé le cuenta a Marco Aurelio que ella y Rómulo vuelven a estar juntos.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se enfurece con Malaver por amenazar su capital. Margot conoce a Alejandro, mientras Marcelo y María del Pilar mantienen un romance secreto que horroriza a Manuela. Elizabeth y Moisés sufren al descubrir que son hermanos, luchando con sus sentimientos. Malaver hace una donación al barrio para ganarse a Manuela, pero Margot le advierte que él es en realidad Néstor Cordido. Katiuska manipula a Ricardo con una foto y planea hacerla pública para causar problemas.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro expulsa a Alberto. Marisela recibe los papeles del divorcio al volver de la clínica. Isaías se rehúsa al despecho bebiendo con Humberto. Adolfo consuela a Consuelo tras la negativa de Erasto. Natalia, prisionera, suplica auxilio. Carmen Rosa evade el tema del matrimonio entre Rosa y Junior por el parentesco secreto. Erasto, hundido, ordena a Arminda desaparecer a Rosa. Adolfo pide a Leticia que interceda para que Consuelo se case con él. Consuelo planea investigar a la familia de Arminda. Natalia grita pidiendo auxilio y Eustoquio acude.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Trinidad descubre que la caja era un regalo de Leo y lee la carta que contenía. Así que va a hablar con él para decirle que se aleje de su nieta. Rebeca le pide a Adolfo que la entregue al novio en la renovación de los votos. Jimena les advierte que podría no ser una buena idea. Leonardo amenaza a Alejandra para que cambie su actitud. Esto pone furiosa a Alejandra y hace que decida desquitarse con Leo. Felipe le dice a Carlos Ernesto que el asesinato de su hermano no fue por motivos amorosos, y que podría haber tenido un enemigo. Irene, Maribel y Mateo van de viaje con Leonardo. A Irene la incómoda la cercanía de Leonardo y teme que se dé cuenta que el bebé es suyo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto quiere hacer el amor con Sol pero esta lo evita hasta que llega el punto en que Heriberto se cansa y la trata mal, llega Alejandro y lo detiene. Sol le dice a Heriberto que no puede estar con él y este se retira, le dice que no lo busque más. Aida le dice a Tabares que está siendo extorsionada por Heriberto y luego llama a Alejandro, le dice que para Heriberto es casi seguro que Sol y él no son hermanos. Alejandro se encuentra con el médico que le dice que el examen estuvo mal.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca aparece cuando lo están llevando preso a Leo y culpa a María Lucía de que él este en problemas, a lo que Trinidad decide irse enojada de la casa junto con Anzola. Cuando estaban saliendo se encontraron con Oriana, quién muy enojada, le dice a Trinidad que Leo le juró que iba a cambiar y que iba a estar con ella, pero Trinidad le dice que este le envió una carta de amor muy importante a su nieta. Leonardo no puede entender cómo es que Irene tuvo un hijo con Felipe y la razón por la cuál ella no lo deja acercarse a Mateo. Irene, enojada, le pide que por favor deje de meterse en su vida privada. Justo en ese momento Rebeca lo llama por teléfono para contarle lo sucedido con Leo, y él planea enfrentar a Alejandra para que saque la denuncia en su contra.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro confirma que no es hermano de Sol y le pide al Médico que le dé un papel donde conste esto. Alejandro increpa a Madroño en la cárcel y este lo apuñala pero la herida es leve y Alejandro no lo delata. Al fin del día Alejandro recibe el pale que tanto esperaba donde consta que él y Sol no son hermanos. Giselle y Bárbara están celosas de Miyogla. Ricarda compra un billete ganador de lotería para respaldar el hecho de que tiene ahora mucho dinero.

programme.title: Till I Met You
programme.desc: Cassandra forms an unlikely friendship with Val and Agnes when they find out they’re being cheated on by the same man. Then, Cassandra is deceived again by a man who leaves her pregnant with Iris. Iris grows up helping her mother until Cassandra meets and marries Oliver, whom she explains to Iris as the man guaranteed by certain signs. Years later, Iris experiences these signs with her best friend, Ali.

programme.title: Till I Met You
programme.desc: Ali quits the Philippine Military Academy, disobeying his father's wishes. Cast out from his home, Ali turns to Iris for help. Ali and Iris's friendship develops into something more as Iris helps Ali pursue his dreams.

programme.title: Ikaw Lang Ang Iibigin
programme.desc: Gabriel secures funds for Rigor's hospital bill, only to learn it was already paid. Percy asks Ben's permission to court Bianca and offers her a rewarding position at his company's Davao site.

programme.title: Ikaw Lang Ang Iibigin
programme.desc: Bianca accepts Percy's job offer in Davao. Roman challenges Carlos to prove himself after learning Gabriel boosted Laban's sales. Bianca and Gabriel cross paths again.

programme.title: The General's Daughter
programme.desc: Tiago shocks everyone as he concedes his defeat in the senatorial elections. He then instructs Alex to proceed with the next step of his devious plan. With Marcial's help, Rhian and Franco try to locate Elai. They also ask Ivan for information as to where Tiago might hide Elai. Later, Isabelle receives a phone call which forces her to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: The General's Daughter
programme.desc: Isabelle agrees on Cuatro's terms in order to be assured of Elai's safety. Bent on saving her chosen family, Rhian arrives to finally come face to face with Cuatro. Meanwhile, Amelia is horrified to learn the effects of Santi's intensive training to become part of the syndicate. She soon confronts Tiago about his secret plan. programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies (2023)
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words
programme.desc: Hear Morello discuss his message and mission in Free Speech + Other Dirty Words, presented by SPIN and the FIRE, and hosted by Ryan Downey.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story (2023)
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story

programme.title: Great Destinations Africa
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Food blogger and cookbook author, Sarah Graham, takes her kitchen on the road through Africa.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: In 1693, an unprecedented earthquake hit the Valley of Noto destroying several small towns such as Modica, Ragusa and Scicli, which were all included in the Norman Kingdom of Sicili. More than 90,000 lives were lost. Giuseppe Lanza, the Spanish appointed viceroy, took charge of the reconstruction of the area. He called on Sicilian architects Giovanni Baptista, Vaccarini and Rosario Gagliardi.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Sustainability and Sport in the Jungle
programme.desc: Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. He visits a monkey sanctuary working to rehabilitate rescued wildlife and ends the day by joining locals in a spirited community soccer tournament—celebrating the role of sport, conservation, and joy in jungle life.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari give viewers a tour of all four Hawaiian islands.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving in beautiful Mauritius Brent has his first taste of their curry. The Indian population has had a huge influence on the cuisine, but Mauritian curries are unique. Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: In 1693, an unprecedented earthquake hit the Valley of Noto destroying several small towns such as Modica, Ragusa and Scicli, which were all included in the Norman Kingdom of Sicili. More than 90,000 lives were lost. Giuseppe Lanza, the Spanish appointed viceroy, took charge of the reconstruction of the area. He called on Sicilian architects Giovanni Baptista, Vaccarini and Rosario Gagliardi.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Sustainability and Sport in the Jungle
programme.desc: Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. He visits a monkey sanctuary working to rehabilitate rescued wildlife and ends the day by joining locals in a spirited community soccer tournament—celebrating the role of sport, conservation, and joy in jungle life.

programme.desc: Los Angeles police lieutenant Rick Hunter (Fred Dryer) seeks the media-hungry serial killer (Miguel Ferrer) who killed his fiancée.

programme.desc: A kickboxer must prevent the launch of a nuclear missile by terrorists targeting New York.

programme.title: Living in Oblivion (1995)
programme.desc: A harried director must contend with technical foul-ups and actors' shenanigans on the set of a low-budget film.

programme.desc: An innocent half-Asian kickboxer is caught between two other races at war in prison.

programme.title: Point Break (1991)
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.

programme.title: The Final Sacrifice (1991)
programme.desc: A teenager's investigation into his father's death leads him to a hidden city populated with menacing warriors.

programme.title: Legionnaire (1998)
programme.desc: A 1920s playboy returns from a stint in the French Foreign Legion to reclaim his lover, a mobster's mistress.

programme.title: Manos, the Hands of Fate (1966)
programme.desc: While on a desert excursion, a family encounters cultists who use human hands as sacrificial offerings to their god.

programme.title: Some Girl (1998)
programme.desc: An insecure young woman (Marissa Ribisi) and her promiscuous best friend (Juliette Lewis) seek relationships.

programme.title: Affliction (1997)
programme.desc: A small-town sheriff (Nick Nolte) becomes unhinged, thanks in part to his abusive, alcoholic father (James Coburn).

programme.title: Unlawful Entry (1992)
programme.desc: A creepy policeman (Ray Liotta) gets close to a Los Angeles couple (Kurt Russell, Madeleine Stowe) in order to drive them apart.

programme.title: The Exorcist III (1990)
programme.desc: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

programme.title: Wild Side (1995)
programme.desc: A banker who moonlights as a call-girl falls in with a sadistic undercover officer (Steven Bauer), a money launderer (Christopher Walken) and his wife (Joan Chen).

programme.title: Love hurts (2024)
programme.desc: Germana is an untalented and unlucky aspiring actress, a somewhat inconsiderate mother and the mistress of a rich lawyer who supports her financially. Elisabetta, her neighbour, on the other hand, is a successful doctor, too closed in her schemes to realise her husband is homosexual until she is left alone with many questions. When Gianmarco, a family man in a work crisis, saves Germana's daughter from an accident, sparks fly between them. Too bad she does not know that he is married and is Elisabetta's friend. Fate brings them face to face with reality when, during a holiday in Sicily, they all meet again, forcing them to confront each other.

programme.title: The Hired Killer (2025)
programme.desc: Hit-man Clint Harris has one more job to do before he can retire. He's to kill an ex-employee who has become a snitch for the police. At first Harris refuses, but when his brothers assassinated, he's forced to accept.

programme.title: His women (2026)
programme.desc: Ugo Tognazzi stars as a naive clerk who lands in trouble when he unknowingly shelters a sex worker.

programme.title: Creeping Death (2026)
programme.desc: Undercover agent Alan Fields hunts a rogue thief who killed his partners to keep the stolen loot.

programme.title: Looking for Paradise (2024)
programme.desc: Inspired by Vite di uomini non illustri by Giuseppe Pontiggia and directed by Mario Monicelli, this film follows Claudia Bertelli, born in Milan in 1949 to a middle-class family. Educated in England, Claudia's life unfolds through diverse roles: rebellious single mother, feminist, wife, doctor in developing countries, and finally a mystical nun. Each phase reflects changing ideals, forming a portrait of a woman exploring identity across different stages of her life.

programme.title: Battlefields

At the height of the fighting, the attackers lost four men per second. The Dieppe raid turned into a massacre!

programme.title: Breakthrough in the East (2025)
programme.desc: January 28, 1945. World War II comes to Germany. Total war, in all its drama, strikes back at the Germans and reaches its climax on German soil.

programme.title: Germany in Ruins (2025)
programme.desc: March 6, 1945. Cologne is the first major German city to fall to the Allies. Stalin plans to conquer Berlin before the other Allies arrive.

programme.title: Downfall and Liberation (2025)
programme.desc: April 16, 1945. The Red Army begins its offensive on Berlin. The first concentration camps have been liberated by British and US forces, who discovered emaciated prisoners and corpses.

programme.title: The East (2025)
programme.desc: After the war, hunger and adversity shape daily life in East Germany. Many Berliners go to the countryside in search of food. In the city, a notorious gang of youths is up to no good.

programme.title: The West (2025)
programme.desc: Robbery, murder, rape. After the war, West Germany is the scene of brutal crimes. On the German-Belgian border, children risk their lives for something to eat.

programme.title: Crime in Post-War Germany (2025)
programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.

programme.title: The D-Days Spies (2025)
programme.desc: Discover how agents tricked the Germans to keep their troops out of Normandy.

programme.title: The Soldier who never was (2025)
programme.desc: Discover a darkly humorous British ploy that helped the 1943 landing in Sicily.

programme.title: The Spy who Saved the World (2025)
programme.desc: Discover how a Soviet Intelligence officer avoided WWIII.

programme.title: The A-Bomb Spies (2025)
programme.desc: Discover how and why several brilliant scientists divulged the secrets of the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Part 1 (2025)
programme.desc: America and Europe in 1491, and why America was discovered and not the other way around.

programme.title: Part 2 (2025)
programme.desc: The true legacy of Columbus is biological, and it created one world out of two.

programme.title: The Maya (2025)
programme.desc: More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.

programme.title: The Aztecs (2025)
programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.

programme.title: The Incas (2025)
programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.

programme.title: First Before Columbus (2025)
programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!

programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun (2025)
programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World (2025)
programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World (2025)
programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World (2025)
programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.

Don’t miss what happens minutes before she’s to appear on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can Dr. Phil convince her to stop running and commit to getting well?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are your kids telling you what to do? Then you won’t want to miss the first in a year-long series on parenting. One couple is at their wit’s end with their teenage daughter who lies about everything! Could the parents be to blame? Plus, how can parents win in a power struggle against pint-size drama queens and bullies? Find out when Dr. Phil tackles effective discipline methods and teaches you how to regain control of your kids!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica says she was instantly attracted to Jason, known as “Tank D.,” one of the stars of CMT’s hit show Redneck Island, and they started dating. But now, Jessica claims the man she loved for over 18 months is an arrogant, self-centered narcissist who cares more about partying and verbally trashing her than their 6-month-old baby son. Jessica says she believes this reality show "celebrity" is not only a deadbeat dad but an abusive, manipulating narcissist who is acting inappropriately with his female fans and firmly believes he cheated on her with Katie, a co-star from Redneck Island. Jason says Jessica knew he was wild from the start and failed to tame his bad boy ways. He admits he’s called Jessica names but adamantly denies he’s ever been physically abusive toward her. Jason says Jessica needs to stop using their son as a manipulative tool, because they are not together. Jason 100 percent denies cheating with Katie on season 5 of Redneck Island, but Katie says otherwise -- and in a shocking revelation, Katie reveals the full truth to Jessica. Will Jason continue to deny the affair or finally admit to cheating?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A 13-year-old's powerful and disturbing diary entries have Dr. Phil very concerned. Trisha says her daughter's pain stems from her father's discipline. How do you know if your discipline crosses the line into abuse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to parents worried about their teen's direction. Plus, how to prevent your teen from bullying.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Aja says she is sick and tired of taking care of her ungrateful, entitled, drug-addicted mother, Janet. Aja says she has allowed her mom to live with her for eight of the 10 years of her marriage. Aja claims she’s spent $100,000 taking care of her mom and that she does absolutely everything for her without any appreciation. Janet rejects Aja’s claim that she is somehow taking advantage of Aja. She says she pays rent, regularly goes to Narcotics Anonymous, so what else does Aja want from her? Aja says she’s glad her mom has made improvements, but it doesn’t make up for her and her older sister, Ashley’s, neglected childhood. Aja claims they were put in constant danger and surrounded by violent criminals and firearms. But Janet says, “I think my past drug addiction has made my girls the women they are today.” Will Aja finally give her mother the boot? Can this family possibly come together after years of animosity? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Seven years ago, Brandon was an out-of-control drug addict, until his LIVE intervention on the Dr. Phil stage led him down the path to sobriety. Now clean for five years, Brandon and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by helping other families confront their loved ones about their destructive addictions. A family desperate to save their three drug-addicted brothers: Sean, 28, Jordan, 24, and Logan, 23, reaches out to Brandon and Debbie for help. It’s an unpredictable event fraught with issues. Don’t miss this dramatic triple intervention!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with women who say they feel forgotten by their loved ones because of their excessive weight. Lorna weighs 650-plus pounds and feels abandoned by her family. Lorna’s sister, Glenice, says Lorna got herself into this situation; now she has to take responsibility and get herself out. Lorna’s boyfriend, Blair, takes care of her, but Glenice says he’s not the Mr. Nice Guy he appears to be. She says he's really an abuser. Lorna says Blair is exhausted and stressed from the hard job of caring for her, and her family needs to help rather than drive him away. Is Lorna ready to stop accepting the abuse and start accepting help? Then, Sunni weighs almost 300 pounds and wants to pursue her dream of being a plus-size model. Her boyfriend, Christian, however, says she’s too fat for the runway, and she should leave that dream to the skinny girls. Sunni says she is big and fabulous, and Christian makes her feel like she should crawl under a rock. Will Sunni be forced to pick between her relationship and her dream? Dr. Phil has some surprises for Sunni.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil takes a hard look into the life of identical twin sisters, Talia and Alissa, who say they are homeless and addicted to heroin, and that nothing seems to stop them from scoring drugs – no matter who it hurts. Watch as they share their daily lives with the Dr. Phil cameras and hear them discuss being 21-year-old “prostitutes” together, explain that they have stolen change from a blind man and once stole from over 50 residents at a nursing home, all to get money for heroin. Dr. Phil’s offer of help includes something so radical, it’s a Dr. Phil show first, surprising the twins, their family and the studio audience. But will Talia and Alissa accept the help offered to try to save their lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former teacher Tanya Ramirez pled guilty for crossing a forbidden line… having sex with a 17-year-old student who attended the school where she taught, and now, she’s done something many find even more unbelievable, she’s suing him and his mother. After pleading guilty to this charge, Ramirez filed a lawsuit against the teen accusing him of “extreme and outrageous” conduct and invasion of privacy for recording their late-night rendezvous. Ramirez claims the teen showed the tape around school for bragging rights. Ramirez says the sex was consensual, and says the student is an adult and he was just fine after the encounter. Teacher and student face off on Dr. Phil’s stage for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is lack of confidence holding you back in your life? Then join today’s guests and enroll in Dr. Phil’s confidence course. Meet one woman who has zero confidence in social situations and says she wishes she were more beautiful, like her identical twin sister! You’ll also meet an artist who used to weigh 500 pounds. He’s shed the weight, but hasn’t shed his fear of talking to women. Plus, will a classically trained pianist overcome her fear of performing in front of crowds? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is fed up with teens being terrorized -- both in the schoolyard and online -- and he’s putting bullies on notice! This summer, he took the battle against cyber bullies before Congress, and now he’s kicking off his own Anti-Bully Movement. Learn how cyber bullying is affecting 12-year-old Dara, and why her mom, Toni, fears the tween may harm herself if she doesn’t get help. Then, hear why Michael, a self-proclaimed cyber bully, defends his keyboard antics. Plus, Congresswoman Carolyn McCarthy weighs in on bullying and cyber bullying and what can be done about this growing epidemic, and Parry Aftab, executive director and founder of StopCyberBullying.org, shares tips to keep your kids safe. Join the movement, and take Dr. Phil’s pledge to fight the abuse!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A family says their relative is a cult leader who calls herself "Mother God."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Anything goes on “Ask Dr. Phil"! A 25-year-old claims she won’t find happiness until she becomes a millionaire…and would even ditch her loved ones to get it! Is her search for wealth unreasonable? Then, meet one empty nester who cries everyday about her daughter leaving for college—and it’s been four years! Also, you’ll be surprised to find out why one woman wouldn’t pick up the phone, even if her life depended on it!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On today’s show, Dr. Phil looks at the roles of married couples. You may think her job looks easy, and she may think you don’t do a thing all day! Dr. Phil puts his own marriage to the test by switching daily routines with his wife, Robin. Can they handle the daily grind of each other’s lives? It’s not as easy as it looks to walk in your spouse’s shoes. You may even walk away from today’s episode with a little better perspective.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Think you’re ready to say, “I do?”… not so fast! Dr. Phil puts 3 newly engaged couples to the test in his Premarital Boot Camp series, with real-life challenges like parenting, fighting, money, and sex. Find out what happens when one couple leaves their “baby” unattended six times and why another couple has to do some major explaining to the California Highway Patrol. Will they all make it to the altar… and who will win big prizes?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues an intense discussion on negotiated infidelity. Chrissy, a mother of three, says her husband, Scott, refuses to dump his girlfriend and wants her to consider an open relationship. During their first appearance, things got heated when Tracy, Scott’s mistress of five years, came onstage to share her side of the story. Will Scott choose between his lover and his wife, or will both women kick him to the curb? Then, not everyone believes cheating is a bad thing. Holly Hill, author of Sugarbabe, says negotiated infidelity empowers women. She and her boyfriend, Dino, have been in an open relationship for three years, and they say this arrangement helps couples avoid strife and mistrust. What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, see a follow up with Charles, one of Dr. Phil’s most controversial guests, who wanted to explore a polyfidelity lifestyle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They beg, borrow, and expect others to pay their way… they’re moochers! First up, Connie wants her freeloading, pot-smoking son to get a life. Then, newlywed Hillary is already sick of supporting her rock star wannabe husband. She wants him to get off the couch and start earning his keep. And what if your own mother was mooching off of you? Dr. Phil thinks it’s time these moochers get a wake-up call!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil rings in 2005 with a “New Year’s Resolutions Week” to help you make changes that really matter! Today he helps tackle the number one issue couples fight about – Money! Eris and Vivian spend so much on designer clothes, they cut out costs that really matter - like groceries! They’ve filed for bankruptcy once, have a home in foreclosure, are more than $28,000 in debt…and they still can’t stop shopping! Thai and CJ live paycheck-to-paycheck and even started to sell their kids' old clothes on eBay just to make ends meet. Dr. Phil has some action plans that can help them and you reach your goals.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Toni says her daughter, Kristine, is battling an alcohol addiction and has resorted to drinking hand sanitizer as a cheap way to get her fix. Kristine says her family is dysfunctional, and they’re the reason she can’t stay sober. Dr. Phil has words of warning for Kristine. After three failed stints in rehab, will she agree to try again -- or risk losing her daughter forever?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Are My Children in a Cult?
programme.desc: A father is fighting for custody of his 4 children because his ex-wife is allegedly in a cult.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Family At War: The Intervention (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Taking the plunge. Tying the knot. Gettin’ hitched. Call it what you like, but with over half of all marriages ending in divorce, you better know what you’re getting into. Today, Dr. Phil’s guests just can’t pull the trigger. Find out how the daughters from one man’s first marriage may be getting in the way; meet a pilot who can’t give up the bachelor lifestyle; and get to know a real “runaway bride.” Are their relationships strong enough to make a lasting marriage? Decide for yourself.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you spend money frivolously, or do you hold on to every cent? Katie says when she and her husband, Joe, were dating, he wined and dined her, but when they got married, he became so cheap that she had to buy her own wedding ring, and he refused to take her on a honeymoon. When Katie lost over 40 pounds and wanted to buy clothes that fit, she says Joe told her to just gain the weight back. Joe says he has to control all of Katie's spending, or they would end up in the poorhouse. Is Joe really the penny-pincher Katie says he is, or is Katie's spending the real problem? Next, Ericka says her friend, Carlena, has "caviar taste with a tuna fish budget," and that if she doesn't learn to control her shopaholic ways, she'll end up on the street. Carlena says she deserves everything she buys -- designer clothes, over 100 pairs of shoes, and the TV in her car -- even if she can't afford them. Carlena's spending has gotten so bad, she had to move back home with her mother, Leonetta. Leonetta joins the show via satellite with all of Carlena's possessions on her lawn. Don’t miss her shocking ultimatum to her daughter!
